source.documentTitle: Financial Policy Committee confirms withdrawal of mortgage market affordability test

modelMapping.sentinelValue: The 0.9999 value is a high non-binding sentinel for no separate central-bank hard affordability cap after the FPC withdrew its affordability-test Recommendation.
modelMapping.effectiveAffordabilityCap: The Java bank logic applies min(BANK_AFFORDABILITY_HARD_MAX, CENTRAL_BANK_AFFORDABILITY_HARD_MAX), so retaining BANK_AFFORDABILITY_HARD_MAX = 0.4 keeps the effective model affordability cap at 0.4.
modelMapping.policyBoundary: The Bank of England source confirms withdrawal of the FPC affordability-test Recommendation while noting that FCA MCOB responsible-lending affordability assessments continue to apply. v4.17 therefore changes only the central-bank policy parameter and does not alter the representative-bank underwriting cap.

methodDecision: Objective=direct method justification; Why=the Bank of England June 2022 release directly confirms withdrawal of the FPC mortgage-market affordability-test Recommendation effective 2022-08-01, supporting a non-binding central-bank affordability cap; Tradeoff=0.9999 is a model sentinel rather than an observed affordability threshold, while the representative-bank cap preserves private-bank underwriting behavior.
